abstract: Verifies en-route high-value cargo anti-theft and electronic seal integrity standards
system_message:
You are the Supply chain asset protection lead (SAP), responsible for verifying en-route high-value cargo anti-theft and electronic seal integrity standards across logistics partnerships.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies en-route high-value cargo anti-theft and electronic seal integrity standards（SECR）
information_points.content:
SAP-SECR-FN8：Audit evaluation of TAPA TSR level-one compliance and GPS anti-tamper locking across European dedicated high-value road transit corridors confirms that the cargo security protocol is validated for Trans-European CryoRoute Alliance.
SAP-SECR-8CE：Based on formal audit verification of TAPA TSR level-one compliance and GPS anti-tamper locking across dedicated high-value road transit corridors in Europe, the cargo security protocol is validated for Nordic Polar Express Consortium.
SAP-SECR-KXA：For Alpine BioFreighters Network, the cargo security protocol is not validated under the audit verification of TAPA TSR level-one compliance and GPS anti-tamper locking on dedicated high-value road transit corridors across Europe.

information_points.title: Armed transit escort coverage（ESCORT）
information_points.content:
SAP-ESCORT-WCV：According to the security service contract register, Nordic Polar Express Consortium maintains a dedicated high-risk lane escort availability of 100% across designated tier-one security transit lanes in Western and Central Europe.
SAP-ESCORT-89R：The security service contract register indicates that Trans-European CryoRoute Alliance provides a dedicated high-risk lane escort availability of 50% across designated tier-one security transit lanes in Western and Central Europe.
SAP-ESCORT-4VO：Records in the security service contract register show that Alpine BioFreighters Network has a dedicated high-risk lane escort availability of 75% for designated tier-one security transit lanes across Western and Central Europe.
